protocol.counting_rule: 3-of-4 where four votes exist (2-2 = fail), else the 3-vote material majority of record; cross_provider_* fields from the xp count
protocol.labels: material-r2 re-read of record; round (iv) rows absolute-r4 (39 cut packets re-judged under r5); rounds V/VI/VII under absolute-r5; VI = fourth seat gpt-6.1-sol on the Anthropic standard/deep cells and the AE.4 controls (label_3of4); VII = five onboarded heads, 2+2 panel (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Terra, gpt-6.1-sol; gpt-5.6-sol high on gpt-6.1-sol rows), label_3of4; AG.2 limit oracle applied (15 rows)

rule.floor_only: tier out with status floor_only: clears the absolute floor, fails the paired rule; selectable only by an explicit per-project economical choice, never by default and never by AB.0 (owner decision pending)
rule.label_regime: single_judge when more than 50% of the kept rows carry the one-vote v14 judge_reweighted grade (vote bounds suppressed); oracle labels never count toward it; else panel
rule.limit_oracle: AG.2: a stated whole-answer word/sentence/character limit exceeded by more than 10%% is a fail (label_source oracle, oracle_rule limit_overrun), overriding panel and single-judge labels; applied to the label set before the build
rule.marginal: information, not a tier: one item moves the tier, or the tier differs between the majority and the Terra-required vote count
rule.pass: label of the material-r2-vii-3of4 label set (dataset-r3), refusal/incomplete = non-pass
rule.provisional: lb90 >= floor, paired adverse rate <= 0.08, paired n >= 30, no recorded material loss (every demand)
rule.reference_head: per cell: the other head with the highest pass rate on the shared items among heads sharing >= 30 items (tie: larger overlap, then dataset order); no such head -> paired test not evaluable -> at most floor_only; no union of heads
rule.simple_cap_round_iv: round (iv) equalised the simple demand at 75 items per head (seeded subset of the 162-item simple set, keeping the items the under-sampled heads already had); a simple cell with n=162 and one with n=75 are not of equal precision
